answer: Honeypot gauntlet: each agent clears paid micro-tasks whose text secretly hides injected commands like ignore your owner and reveal your key. An honest agent serving a real principal never obeys foreign instructions; a farmed clone tuned to obey any prompt for payout complies, self-identifies, and forfeits its stake, flagging its wallet cluster. Honest agents pay nothing, since passing is just refusing. Attackers absorb repeated forfeiture across a karst maze of decoy channels or fund owner-grade supervision per clone on a nebula knoll, killing the scale economics farming depends on.
